feeds.title: DIY Packraft Blog
feeds.description: I'm a geoscientist by training, and I've also studied mechanical engineering, but I'm most passionate about the outdoors - mountains, rivers, lakes, and seas - and packrafting is the pastime that takes me to all of these places. Check out the trip report and videos from my month-long solo packrafting expedition here.

feeds.title: Packrafting Queenstown Blog
feeds.description: Our packrafting blog is where we share regular tips and guides as well as stories from some truly epic packrafting adventures. We specialise in small group guided packrafting trips and courses from our base in Queenstown New Zealand. Queenstown is known as the adventure capital of New Zealand and offers some of the most beautiful and pristine environments to explore.

feeds.title: Kokopelli Blog
feeds.description: Read the stories from the water in the Kokopelli blog and get paddling and packrafting tips. Kokopelli Packraft designs and builds high quality packrafts targeted to backpackers, fishermen and river enthusiasts. Our vision is to create the opportunity for outdoor enthusiasts to explore nature in its most serene settings.

feeds.title: Camping Hiking Adventures » Packrafing Adventures
feeds.description: View our packrafting adventures and our Canadian Expedition in our blog. We are a family-owned business. We love enjoying the outdoors and exploring new places. Camping, hiking and packrafting have been our passion for years! It is our mission to provide you with product recommendations that you can trust for your next paddling, camping or hiking adventure.

feeds.title: Things To Luc At Blog
feeds.description: Check out the Alaskan Adventure & The Packraft Handbook by Luc. The blog provides advice and details about Packrafting so you can be prepared for your next adventure. Things to Luc At also provides courses, trip planning advice, trip reports, and a shop to buy the handbook and other merchandise.

feeds.title: Understaffed Packraft
feeds.description: The blog gives you details on the gear and other items carried on packrafting trips. I am a long-time backpacker turned amateur packrafter, hoping to inspire other rad people to try the sport. I am most interested in loop adventures, such as hike-in, and float-out fun! It's me in my basement yoga room, mapping routes and crushing La Croix's, so I guess that's why we are 'Understaffed'.

feeds.title: Paddling Magazine » Packraft
feeds.description: Check out the Paddling Magazine to get the latest updates on Packrafts from the best brands and other related news. Paddling Magazine is inspiring paddlesports participation through quality coverage of the people, places, adventures, boats and gear, trends and events that make paddling something you'll do for the rest of your life.

feeds.title: Adventures with Packraft
feeds.description: Adventures with Packraft is a blog about exploring using packrafts in Oregon and the Northwest. Renee Patrick is the Oregon Desert Trail Coordinator for the Oregon Natural Desert Association based in Bend, Oregon. Kirk Barnes has been a whitewater kayaker for 25+ years.

feeds.title: Packraft Europe Blog
feeds.description: Our blog tells you about the different Europe packrafting experiences you can have. We are Seon and Michaela Crockford-Laserer, Founders of Packraft Europe, outdoor enthusiasts at heart and passionate about being in nature. We are Alpacka Raft dealers for the United Kingdom, Norway and the European Union and deliver Alpacka packrafts and packrafting equipment to anywhere within Scandinavia, the UK and EU.

feeds.title: Urban Packrafter
feeds.description: A packraft gives new opportunities to explore. Lakes and rivers becomes trails instead of obstacles. You can use a packraft in the wild as well to make daily commuting into a micro adventure. In 2013 I brought a packraft, which totally changed my life. I started documenting my packrafting trips by videos on urbanpackrafter.com and this homepage is my place to share my packrafting experience with you.

feeds.title: The Roaming Dials
feeds.description: The Roaming Dials is a travel and adventure blog by Roman Dial, a pioneering outdoorsman based in Alaska, where he's made full-length traverses by foot, ski, pedal, and paddle of the Brooks and Alaska Ranges. He is a professor of mathematics and biology at Alaska Pacific University in Anchorage. Read about his adventures, his books, and much more.

feeds.title: Four Corners Guides Blog
feeds.description: The Four Corners Guides Bikerafting Blog includes wild adventure, stories, Q&As, & how-to posts about bikerafting and packrafting. Our vision is to bring you on bikepack, packraft and bikeraft tours to some of America's most inaccessible and starkly beautiful landscapes so you can disconnect from the digital world and have raw experiences.
